'''Kenichirou Matsuda''' (Japanese: '''松田健一郎''' ''Matsuda Ken'ichirō'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Matsuda was born on January 22, 1978, in {{wp|Saitama Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where he voiced [[Rose]].
